name: Ginger tea
description: Fresh ginger simmered in water — the first thing made at the first sign of a chill.

tcm.note: Sheng jiang releases the exterior and warms the middle — the classic first-day-of-a-cold drink.

ayurveda.note: Ardraka is ushna and deepana, the universal digestive kindler.

unani.note: Zanjabeel is garam-khushk in a high degree.

histamine.note: Very low — one of the safest hot drinks on a reactive day.

effects.note: Traditionally the first thing reached for against nausea and motion sickness across all four cuisines this app covers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.

Ginger powder has gone head to head with mefenamic acid and ibuprofen for period pain in randomised trials and come out equivalent — a genuinely well-replicated finding, not a folk claim standing alone. The trial dose is close to what a strong daily cup or two of fresh ginger tea delivers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
